races.display_title: David Clarke Memorial 'National Hunt' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: RIDE LIKE A GIRL holds the clear edge on form and looks to have been found a good opportunity to bag a second success over hurdles. Tom George has his string in excellent nick and his Worcester bumper scorer Dark Tide Rising appeals as the one to chase home Jamie Snowden's mare ahead of fellow hurdling newcomer Whin Cover . RIDE LIKE A GIRL (FR) DARK TIDE RISING (IRE) WHIN COVER

races.display_title: Autumn Racing Weekend Amateur Jockeys' Handicap (Male Amateurs)
races.verdict: This is wide open. TEX has gained both his victories here (first over C&D) and scored in good style in amateur company last time out so is fancied to defy a 6 lb weights rise with Simon Walker a significant booking. Recent Ffos Las winner Kaleidoscope Eyes heads the list of dangers under a 5-lb penalty, although Rock Opera is weighted to go well and represents last year's successful connections. Norcross Brow is another who can play a prominent role in his bid for a fourth win of 2026. TEX (FR) KALEIDOSCOPE EYES (IRE) ROCK OPERA

races.verdict: INFRAAD found another chunk of improvement when keeping on well for success in the Melrose at York and, with further progress still to come, he is taken to land the hat-trick up in grade. races.verdict: A tight-knit handicap but GEMINI MAN is proving very reliable this season and can gain a deserved fourth success on the back of a good recent C&D second. Millbuie is still searching for a first victory but arrives in good nick and could emerge as the main danger ahead of recent C&D scorer Koko Blue and the handily-weighted We've Got This . GEMINI MAN (IRE) MILLBUIE KOKO BLUE

races.verdict: BLACK CAB was a bit disappointing at Newcastle on his most recent outing in July but remains unexposed at 5f and is well worth another chance now returning to a track where he goes particularly well at. Fancy Dancer went down fighting at Bath last month and can go well again, while Spirited Dancer is also of interest having made an encouraging start for the Tony Carroll stable at the aforementioned venue. BLACK CAB (FR) FANCY DANCER SPIRITED DANCER

races.display_title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mucklemeg Mares Flat Race (Listed)
races.verdict: A hotly-contested listed bumper which looks sure to make for good form. ELEGANTEMENTE 's debut win received a timely boost when the runner-up made all at Listowel last week, so she's put forward as the answer for all that she's presumably passed over by John Gleeson for stablemate Lola O C , who also impressed first time up at Roscommon. Long'way is the clear pick of the Willie Mullins trio, while Sarahs Lawn and Thelittleballerina are others to take seriously. ELEGANTEMENTE (FR) LOLA O C (IRE) LONG'WAY (FR)
races.betting_forecast: Long'way (3/1), Thelittleballerina (7/2), Elegantemente (4/1), Sarahs Lawn (7/1), Alicious (8/1), Lola O C (10/1), Village Dream (10/1), Hutton Star (12/1), Missouri Snow (14/1), Weaponized (20/1), False Dawn (20/1), Bonnie Loch (33/1), Lake Pippaway (100/1)
